item.text: The write paths are concentrated in services, and the subscription repository already makes plan changes active. I’m adding the checks there so actions and API callers share the same behavior.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/types/billing.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('export type BillingInterval', 'export type WorkspaceLockReason = \"past_due\" | \"canceled\" | \"trial_ended\";\\n\\nexport type BillingInterval').replace('  readonly subscription: Subscription;\\n  readonly checks:', '  readonly subscription: Subscription;\\n  readonly lockReason: WorkspaceLockReason | null;\\n  readonly checks:'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/types/organization.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import type { PlanId }','import type { PlanId, WorkspaceLockReason }').replace('export interface OrganizationSummary {','export interface OrganizationSummary {\\n  readonly lockReason: WorkspaceLockReason | null;'); p.write_text(s)
Path('src/lib/billing-lock.ts').write_text('''import type { Subscription, WorkspaceLockReason } from \"@/types/billing\";\\nimport type { OrgId } from \"@/types/common\";\\n\\nexport class WorkspaceLockedError extends Error {\\n  readonly code = \"plan_limit_exceeded\";\\n  constructor(readonly orgId: OrgId, readonly reason: WorkspaceLockReason) {\\n    super("'`Workspace is read-only: ${reason}`);'"\\n    this.name = \"WorkspaceLockedError\";\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nexport function lockReasonFor(subscription: Subscription | null, now: Date = new Date()): WorkspaceLockReason | null {\\n  if ("'!subscription) return null;'"\\n  switch (subscription.status) {\\n    case \"past_due\": return \"past_due\";\\n    case \"trialing\": return now.getTime() >= new Date(subscription.currentPeriodEnd).getTime() ? \"trial_ended\" : null;\\n    case \"canceled\": return subscription.cancelAt === null || now.getTime() >= new Date(subscription.cancelAt).getTime() ? \"canceled\" : null;\\n    case \"active\": return null;\\n  }\\n}\\n''')
p=Path('src/lib/errors.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import { FeatureDisabledError', 'import { WorkspaceLockedError } from \"@/lib/billing-lock\";\\nimport { FeatureDisabledError').replace('    error instanceof PermissionDeniedError ||','    error instanceof WorkspaceLockedError ||\\n    error instanceof PermissionDeniedError ||').replace('  if (error instanceof PermissionDeniedError) {','  if (error instanceof WorkspaceLockedError) {\\n    return { code: error.code, message: error.message, meta: { reason: error.reason } };\\n  }\\n\\n  if (error instanceof PermissionDeniedError) {'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/billing-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import { emit }', 'import { lockReasonFor, WorkspaceLockedError } from \"@/lib/billing-lock\";\\nimport { emit }').replace('    subscription,\\n    checks,','    subscription,\\n    lockReason: lockReasonFor(subscription),\\n    checks,'); pos=s.index('/**\\n * The one place a quota'); s=s[:pos]+'''export async function assertWorkspaceWritable(orgId: OrgId, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<void> {\\n  const reason = lockReasonFor(await subscriptionRepo.findSubscription(orgId), now);\\n  if (reason) throw new WorkspaceLockedError(orgId, reason);\\n}\\n\\n'''+s[pos:]; p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/organization-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import { emit }','import { lockReasonFor } from \"@/lib/billing-lock\";\\nimport { emit }').replace('    organization,\\n    usage:', '    organization,\\n    lockReason: lockReasonFor(await subscriptionRepo.findSubscription(orgId)),\\n    usage:'); p.write_text(s)
files={'issue':['issue:create','issue:update','issue:assign','issue:archive'], 'comment':['comment:create','comment:update','comment:delete'], 'project':['project:create','project:update','project:archive'], 'label':['project:update','project:archive'], 'attachment':['issue:update'], 'member':['member:update_role','member:remove'], 'invitation':['member:invite'], 'organization':['org:update'], 'feature-flag':['org:manage_flags'], 'webhook':['webhook:manage']}
import re
for name,actions in files.items():
 p=Path(f'src/server/services/{name}-service.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s='import { assertWorkspaceWritable } from \"./billing-service\";\\n'+s
 lines=s.splitlines(); out=[]; current=''
 for line in lines:
  m=re.match(r'export async function (\\w+)',line)
  if m: current=m.group(1)
  out.append(line)
  if 'assertCan(actor,' in line and any('\"'+a+'\"' in line for a in actions):
   if name=='webhook' and current=='listWebhooks': continue
   org='actor.orgId' if name=='invitation' and current in ('revokeInvitation','resendInvitation') else ('orgId' if current in ('archiveIssue','restoreProject','deleteLabel') else 'input.orgId')
   out.append(f'  await assertWorkspaceWritable({org});')
 s='\\n'.join(out)+'\\n'
 if name=='invitation': s=s.replace('  const existing = await memberRepo.findMember(invitation.orgId, userId);','  await assertWorkspaceWritable(invitation.orgId);\\n\\n  const existing = await memberRepo.findMember(invitation.orgId, userId);')
 p.write_text(s)
PY
